newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-METZ QUALIFY DESPITE 2-1 DEFEAT AT SPORTING LISBON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-METZ QUALIFY DESPITE 2-1 DEFEAT AT SPORTING LISBON.

text.p: Striker Ricardo Sa Pinto scored twice in Sporting Lisbon's 2-1 victory over Metz on Tuesday but the French team qualified for the third round of the UEFA Cup 3-2 on aggregate.
Metz, reduced to 10 men for the last five minutes after Pascal Pierre was sent off, had goalkeeper Lionel Letizi to thank for their success.
He kept his side in the game with some good saves early on, including a spectacular shot from Moroccan midfielder Mustapha Hadji in the seventh minute which Letizi deflected for a corner.
But Metz midfielder Frederic Arpinon eased his side's nerves, with a 17th goal after a mistake by Sporting's Belgian goalkeeper Filip de Wild.
This goal disrupted Sporting's rhythm and it took them until early in the second half before they resumed the offensive.

Sporting's Ivorian striker Ahmed Ouattara hit the post with a header from a cross by Sa Pinto in the 55th minute but in the 73rd minute Sa Pinto equalised with a shot from inside the box after dribbling past three defenders.
He scored a second goal 10 minutes later in a scramble for the ball but Metz held on and went through 3-2 on aggregate.
